response.query: How can internship quality be pre-measured and validated (index components, supervisor ratings, task logs) to avoid endogenous bias?
response.answer: Internship quality can be pre-measured using supervisor ratings, task logs, and index components to avoid endogenous bias. These methods provide objective data for assessment.
